entries.content:
Tarshish. Ps 72:10; Isa 66:19 Kittim.These, and other words ending in {im,} forming the Hebrew plural, are not the names of individuals, but of nations.

Nu 24:24; Isa 23:1,12; Jer 2:10; Eze 27:6; Da 11:30 Chittim. Dodanim. or, Rodanim, according to some copies.
